# Concrete Parachute

> Concrete Parachute is an Atlanta, Georgia heavy melodic rock and post-hardcore band (formed in Griffin, GA). Debut single "Torrent" releases January 8, 2027; follow-up "Drifting Awake" releases February 19, 2027.

## Key pages
- [Home, releases, tour dates, merch, booking](https://concreteparachute.com/)
- [Press kit (EPK)](https://concreteparachute.com/epk)

## Facts
- Members: Chad Askew (lead guitar, co-lead vocals), Brandon Halvorsen (rhythm guitar, co-lead vocals), Josh Hollums (bass), Michael Hayes (drums)
- Booking: booking@concreteparachute.com, 404-855-0849
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/17jSWTukLrxGjG3ZWzPbWa
- Bandsintown: https://www.bandsintown.com/a/15667129
